source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text: For confirmation of the final dimensions, I have added all measurements obtained so far to a preview drawing; this is not the final drawing. Please either remeasure the indicated dimensions or confirm them. In the preview, the shaft is depicted fully assembled and in its fully retracted position.

execution.observed_behavior: Freelancer reports adding all measurements obtained so far to a non-final preview drawing for dimensional confirmation.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text: Because the overall dimension already gives the minimum and maximum values for the full travel, adding the indicated dimension would duplicate it. I need guidance before proceeding: should I retain the current overall dimension, or remove it and use the one you indicated instead?

ambiguity.description: It is unresolved whether to retain the existing overall travel dimension or replace it with the newly indicated dimension.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
The overall length is acceptable, but the functional dimension is the distance between those holes. Please add that dimension, and perhaps show the overall dimension in brackets.
First, send the final drawing set in pdf so that I can confirm it; only after that should you export the other formats.
The final deliverables should be PDF+DWG and STEP, together with native editable solidworks 3D part, assembly and drawing files.

value_updates.functional_dimension: add the distance between the indicated holes
value_updates.overall_dimension: retain the overall length, preferably shown in brackets
